facts.business: Globe International Carriers Limited operates as an asset-light logistics aggregator providing freight and transportation services (FTL and LTL), customs clearance, and warehousing solutions across India, with subsidiaries in hospitality/real estate (Govind Kripa Infratech) and solar EPC/transport (Intraglobe Green Energy).

segments.name: Real Estate and Hospitality (Govind Kripa Infratech)
Solar EPC and Transport (Intraglobe Green Energy)

capacity_or_capex.item: Advance to Mr. Khyat Prakash Shah for warehouse land purchase
Advance to Dispar Fintrade Private Ltd for proposed land purchase
Advance to Darwin Platform Infrastructure for warehouse construction on leasehold land
capacity_or_capex.timeline: FY 2024-25 (₹0.6 cr recovered in FY 2025-26, balance ₹12.4 cr recoverable)

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of 51% stake in Govind Kripa Infratech Private Limited

auditor.name: Gourisaria Goyal & Co. (Standalone), CSM & Co. (Secretarial)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Audit noted delays in trading window closure confirmation (submitted March 30, 2026 vs March 27 deadline) and board meeting intimation timeline non-compliance (Aug 25, 2025 intimation for Aug 28 meeting with holiday on Aug 27). Also noted non-compliance with Sections 185/186 for certain loans to entities where directors are interested.

key_risks: Indirect exposure to fuel price volatility through third-party fleet owner hire rates
Non-compliance with Sections 185 and 186 of Companies Act for loans to director-interested entities
Delays in regulatory filings (trading window closure, board meeting intimation)
Advances for capex projects without registered agreements (partly recovered, balance recoverable)
Dependence on aggregated fleet model without direct control over capacity or fuel costs
facts.related_party_note: Advances given to Mr. Khyat Prakash Shah (₹520 lakh), Dispar Fintrade Private Ltd (₹200 lakh), and Darwin Platform Infrastructure (₹1,100 lakh) for proposed capex projects without registered agreements; ₹520 lakh from Shah fully recovered, ₹60 lakh from Darwin recovered, ₹1,240 lakh balance recoverable. Acquisition of 51% in Govind Kripa Infratech via share swap (30,69,147 shares issued at ₹95.90/share).
